hunks.baseline: A perfect silence settled over the grand banquet hall—not even the smallest breath could be heard.
hunks.sol: Perfect silence settled over the Grand Banquet Hall. Not even the faintest breath could be heard.

hunks.baseline: Along with it came countless eyes, wide with shock, all fixed on one person.
hunks.sol: Countless eyes stared at one man.

hunks.baseline: Everyone wondered the same thing at once. Looking toward the young man at the end of their gazes, they recalled the remark they’d just heard.
hunks.sol: Everyone wondered the same thing. As they stared at the young man, they recalled the words that had just rung through the hall.

hunks.baseline: The words had rung out clearly enough for everyone in the hall to hear.
hunks.sol: Everyone had heard him clearly.

hunks.baseline: They doubted their memories once, twice, ten times, but reality refused to change. Forgetting all about decorum, people gaped at him, barely managing to swallow the curses on the tips of their tongues.
hunks.sol: They questioned their memories once, twice, ten times, but the words never changed. Forgetting all decorum, they gaped at him and barely managed to swallow the curses on their tongues.

hunks.baseline: Even calling him crazy fell far short of describing what that young man, Jin Taekyung, had just done.

hunks.baseline: He’d provoked the Emperor to his face.
hunks.sol: He had provoked the Emperor to his face.

hunks.sol: “And a man who wishes to become a sage king does not punish those who speak the truth.”

hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung swallowed the rest of the thought.

hunks.sol: The moment I saw Wei Zhong, I thought of an old fantasy movie I’d watched as a kid.

hunks.sol: A vast fantasy world. A party of heroes from different races setting out to destroy a certain necklace that was the source of the Demon King’s power.
